title: Console sizes are tokens
asked: Backfilled from CLAUDE.md Status (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: `console.css` and the console views use `--fx-space`, `--fx-font-size`, `--fx-radius-*` and `--fx-border-w` (exact at the default soft-studio theme, so it looks pixel-identical there); the console is held to every theme rule. Shapes stay fixed: pill radii (999px), bar/chart heights, icon sizes.
